annotation_method: All three full unmarked 96x96 context panels plus nearest-neighbor 8x central zoom actually viewed for each item. Full-frame overviews establish camera/content context. Seven named native frames were additionally viewed directly. Bounds are literal manual observations; publisher centers/component proposals were not adopted as labels.
export_blockers: Frozen event aliases contain newly observed Miami/Washington, Dubai/Rome, Libema/Halle and ATP-Finals-year/city inconsistencies. Root must conservatively union all observed source-event edges, including rejected and unsupported items, and resolve train/development assignments before any label export.
Independent human review remains absent. These are private agent-reviewed development observations, not independent test truth.
Bounding boxes have uncalibrated manual endpoint tolerance; no detector, event, physical-speed or final-test accuracy is established.
